title: release-lanes: many agents advance one release line in parallel without conflicts (Mandate 74 section 3)
goal: Turn a local-distill plan into lanes with disjoint file scopes on refs/candidates/release/<name>, with atomic create-if-absent lane claims under refs/claims/release-lanes, in-memory cherry-pick -x picks with patch-id dedup, exact-tree evidence, atomic fast-forward advancement that releases the claim, and a bounded ship loop that re-picks after a lost race. No force, no deletion of release lines, no hosting API.
validation: cargo test --locked -p xtask --bin release-lanes release_lanes::: 6 passed, 0 failed; cargo clippy -p xtask --bin release-lanes --tests -D warnings: clean; end to end on real Susi history through the real push-policy hook into a scratch bare remote: 3 tasks, 2 lanes, 2 agents, one lost race recovered by ship, release tree matched main for every selected file. Full workspace suite not run.
